weighting: equal weight for each problem, equal weight for instances within each problem
pair_correction: diagnostic only: change existing errors in the selected pairs to native winner

mechanism.sampling: size-stratified, independent of errors and winner
mechanism.subset_rule: identical retained customer-start IDs for both methods
mechanism.winner_ties: exact native costs; ties reported separately, never called strict flips
mechanism.sensitive: at least one strict reversal in 20 offline subsets
